A sand embankment collapsed onto tents in Deir al-Balah on 8 November, killing five people. Health Ministry figures say 350,000 displaced people were sleeping in the open as of 9 November. Rescue searches for missing people were continuing on 9 November.

usgs-earthquake-us6000u1cf.summary: A magnitude 7.5 to 7.7 earthquake (sources vary; the feed lists 6.0) struck near Tonosí, Los Santos, Panama, on 9 October 2026. Its epicentre was 39 km north-west of Tonosí. As of 30 October, SINAPROC reports 2 deaths, 27 injured and 55,245 people in affected areas. The government declared a national state of emergency on 10 October. Response and humanitarian assistance are ongoing.

usgs-earthquake-us6000u1wn.summary: A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck 17 km west of Río Grande, Panama, on 12 October 2026 at 23:20 UTC, at a depth of 11 km (USGS). Washington Post and CNN Español reported no immediate casualties or property damage. Panama City was shown only light shaking. No update was found after 13 October 2026.

usgs-earthquake-us6000u2y1.summary: A magnitude 5.7 to 5.9 earthquake struck near Khuzdar in Balochistan, Pakistan, on 17 October 2026. Agencies gave different magnitudes and depths. One person was killed by a rock falling from a mountain in the Naal area, and several traditional mud houses were damaged. The latest report found is dated 18 October 2026.
